name: develop-with-worktrees
description: A host-neutral Git safety lifecycle for isolated worktrees, task anchors, verified candidates, and safe candidate-first integration.

interface.shortDescription: Safe worktrees and automatic verified candidate batches.
interface.longDescription: Route repository lifecycle ownership, isolate modifying tasks, keep a local task anchor, validate exact candidates, and integrate locally without remote side effects. New repositories automatically freeze each full candidate batch; a smaller exact tail freezes only after its persisted producer lane stays quiet or after an explicit user, deployment, or dependency request. Native host task/subagent tools own task orchestration, and Codex hooks remain optional hardening.
capabilities: Automatic full batches and exact quiet or explicit tails
defaultPrompt: Use $develop-with-worktrees to route and safely complete this Git change.
Use $develop-with-worktrees to publish verified candidates, auto-integrate full batches, and close the exact final tail.
